questions.question: After one selection-sort pass that swaps the smallest remaining value into index 0, what is [4, 2, 7, 1]?
questions.explanation: Selection sort finds the minimum of the unsorted suffix and swaps it into the next position.

questions.question: After the first insertion-sort step (inserting index 1 into the sorted prefix), what is [4, 2, 7, 1]?
questions.explanation: Shift the previous larger value right and insert the saved value into the prefix.

questions.question: How many comparisons find the minimum for the first selection-sort pass on [4, 2, 7, 1]?
questions.explanation: Start with the first value as minimum and compare the other three.

questions.question: What order results from a complete ascending sort of [4, 2, 7, 1]?
questions.explanation: Ascending order places smaller values before larger values.
